witness_description: The simple undirected graph on vertices {0,1,2} with edges {0-1,0-2} has k=2 and three nonempty simple paths up to reversal: 0-1, 0-2, and 1-0-2.
refutation_explanation: For this witness, k! = 2. There are three distinct paths even after identifying each path with its reverse, and every listed path uses each edge at most once. Since 3 > 2, the claimed upper bound fails.
search_space: All 12 labeled finite simple undirected graphs on vertex sets {0,...,n-1} for n=0,1,2,3 (all 2^(n choose 2) edge subsets), with every nonempty vertex-simple path exhaustively enumerated and paths identified with their reversals.
